messages:
ana: FYI I uploaded a new launch post draft (two assets: highlights + gated deck). Link: https://drive.redwood/infer/launch-draft-2026 — need quick alignment: benchmark narrative, CTA flow, webinar timing, HS routing by EOD tomorrow.

jamie: I'll do editorial pass tonight. Move the headline to be benefit-first and surface a key stat above the fold.

mike: Bench note: include HW, median latency, token avg and whether KV cache was used. Small methods snippet will avoid followups.

devon: Infra will upload CSV + run IDs by 9am. Webinar preferred slots: Tue 6/22 10am PT or Thu 6/24 6pm PT. We'll let registrants pick.

lisa: Legal quick-pass: avoid superlatives like "fastest". Suggested phrasing: "among the most cost-efficient for latency-sensitive chat workloads". Add privacy link on form + consent checkbox.

ana (typo): sorry, that was me — tagging @lisa for sign-off on claims.

ana: CTA plan: 1) Start trial (no gate) 2) Download deep-dive (gated). Gated CTA copy draft: "Download the deep-dive benchmark deck — runs, configs, and cost breakdowns."

mike: tweak: "Download the deep-dive benchmark deck — detailed runs, configs, and cost breakdowns."

jamie: move charts above the "how it works" section — shows impact sooner. Also add 2-line routing fallback blurb.

devon: routing blurb: "Smart routing maintains latency SLOs by automatically routing to compatible model variants when capacity is constrained." Will confirm queue name for HS.

publish-bot: REVIEW checklist: marketing 705 | legal pending | product 705 | infra pending | hero asset missing | publish date unset.

ana: timeline: editorial finish tonight, infra CSV by 9am, legal quick-pass by 11am, HS form by noon, design hero by EOD. Target publish Wed next week if all green.

mike: I'll prep the demo script (cost comp + routing failover).

lisa: ping me after CSV attach and I'll sign off quickly.

ana: thanks team 389 closing for now; will reopen with v2 link.
